Useful commands:
*  help         see this message again
*  ppk          show autogenerated public key for SSH access

Terraform:
* terraform    see https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/docs

  Common use cases:
    terraform init
    terraform apply
    terraform destroy

Ansible:
*  ansible-playbook see https://docs.ansible.com/projects/ansible/latest/getting_started/index.html

   Common use cases:
     ansible-playbook -i inventory.yml site.yml

Kubernetes:
*  kubeadm      see https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/setup-tools/kubeadm/
*  kubectl      see https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/kubectl/
*  helm         see https://helm.sh/docs/intro/using_helm/

   Common use cases:
     kubectl get nodes -o wide
     kubectl get pods
     kubectl apply -f some-manifest.yml

AWS:
*  aws          see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/

   Common use cases:
     aws configure
     aws ec2 describe-instances
